change: Continuous gravity-referenced roll/pitch with wheel-derived kinematic acceleration removed, window-aligned, with an accelerometer trust gate. Stationary ZUPT tilt retained and preferred.
method: Headless d3d12 Gazebo, agv_localization regression driven straight at 2.0 m/s for 30 s (62.3 m). Identical build and motion; only motion_tilt_enabled and the noise seed differ. Lateral/longitudinal 3-sigma reproduce the capture_audit footprint propagation. Truth roll/pitch come from /ground_truth/odom and are used ONLY for evaluation.
budget_note: Coverage certification needs lateral 3-sigma <= swath/2 - spacing/2 = 0.75 - 0.50 = 0.25 m.
limits: Straight 62 m constant-speed pass on flat ground; not a mission, not 100x10 m acceptance.
Transient phases are rejected by the trust gate and coast on the gyro; missions do not capture during ACCELERATE/RUNOUT_BRAKE.
Consistency is checked against simulator truth; it does not certify real GNSS/IMU hardware or sloped ground.
